_note: World coordinates (art px). The 640x270 core is x 0..640, y 0..270; the painted art spans x -80..720, y -96..384 (800x480, the first room's frame). Keys 1-7 run left to right (also the arrow loop). focus = what a zone step-in frames (~1/3 of the room, 16:9, hotspots plus margin). stop = zone centre x for the phone pan; phoneStop is clamped for a 120 px wide portrait slice. territory = x range of the zone's hotspots.

camera.defaultZoomNote: default view is up to 1.3x closer than the full core, rounded down to a whole number so pixels stay even, and still shows the whole core; no mouse-look parallax; depth layers move only during the zoom dolly and the phone pan

leftWall.formula: top y = 62 - 0.15 (176 - x); bottom y = 198 + 0.19375 (176 - x) (the first room's raked flats)

projection.note: P(X, h, Z) = (320 + F X / Z, 121 + F (EYE - h) / Z) in art px; left wall X = -HALF - K (ZB - Z)

centre.sunbeam: floor patch from the window toward the statue and the rug

layers._note: Depth bands (feet from the camera, back wall at 48). Objects take the band of their NEAREST floor contact or wall depth. No mouse parallax: layers separate only during the zoom dolly and the phone pan. Shell bands overlap 1.6 ft into the nearer band so a dolly never opens seams. Items may carry 'contact' (sort key); use it instead of y + h when present (flat rugs/mats use their top edge, things on a counter or table sort after it).
layers.L0: sky, sun, clouds, far oaks (window view)
layers.L1: New Orleans outside: shotgun houses, streetcar, power lines, near oak
layers.L2: back wall and everything on it; depth >= 44 ft: library, statue, window, CRTs, study desk, nightstand
layers.L3: depth 40..44: bed, armchair, computer desk, whiteboard, both relic mounts
layers.L4: depth 35..40: door, doormat, switchboard, running wall, medals
layers.L5: depth < 35: counter, kitchen table, cushion, chess table, rug, bike, weight rack, front floor
layers.L6: frame crops in the bleed (speaker, leaves, boxes, cables); never over a hotspot

skills._note: Every skill maps to exactly one hotspot object. Bodyweight logs in the Food panel.
